steps.say: Rotten perineal skin is staged spreading alarmingly fast. Fournier gangrene is staged as polymicrobial flesh death. Aerobic with anaerobic bacteria are staged acting synergistically together. Perineal with perianal and genital planes are invaded jointly. Diabetes with immunosuppression is staged predisposing most cases. Foul odour with crepitus is staged sealing the diagnosis.
steps.tx: **Fournier gangrene** (perineal flesh death) is rapidly progressive **polymicrobial necrotizing fasciitis** (mixed bacteria fascial rot) of perineal, perianal, and genital planes with aerobic plus anaerobic synergy. Suspect with pain beyond skin signs, crepitus, and foul odour. Start resuscitation with antibiotics at once, because hours decide survival.

vis.alt: Fournier gangrene with fascial spread across perineum.
vis.caption: Fournier gangrene: polymicrobial fascial rot spreads by hours. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Vessels are staged clotting ahead of the visible edge. Endarteritis obliterans is staged blocking small vessels. Bacterial toxins are staged injuring the vessel lining directly. Microvascular thrombosis is staged starving skin rapidly. Necrosis is staged advancing two to three cm hourly. The edge is staged marching visibly between reviews.
steps.tx: **Endarteritis obliterans** (vessel wall inflammation) from bacterial toxins drives **subcutaneous thrombosis** (under skin clotting) with necrosis racing at **2 cm to 3 cm per hour** (two to three centimetres hourly). Mark the edge with time stamps. Re-examine within hours, because the border outruns the mark.

steps.say: The scrotal contents are staged surviving often unscathed. Testes are staged spared despite scrotal skin loss. Their arteries are staged arising directly from the aorta. Perineal fascial supply is staged separately perfused. Sloughed scrotal skin is staged leaving testes for thigh burial. Later reconstruction is staged covering the buried gonads.
steps.tx: **Testicular sparing** (gonads survive) is classic because the **testicular artery** (aortic gonad supply) arises from the aorta, separate from perineal fascial vessels. Bury exposed testes in thigh pouches temporarily. Reconstruct scrotum after infection clears, because gonads usually work afterwards. Document viability with Doppler when doubted.

steps.say: The knife is staged saving more than drugs here always. Radical debridement is staged as the survival factor. All necrotic tissue is staged cutting until bleeding margins. Viable bleeding edges are staged as the endpoint. Returns to theatre are scheduled daily until clean. Closure is planned only on clean granulation.
steps.tx: **Radical surgical debridement** (wide dead tissue cut) to **viable bleeding margins** (healthy oozing edges) is the top survival determinant. Cut until tissue bleeds and re-look daily. Never temporize with antibiotics alone, because dead tissue shields bacteria. Extend margins generously beyond dusky borders.

vis.alt: Fournier gangrene debridement to bleeding margins.
vis.caption: Debride radically to viable bleeding margins daily. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Severity scoring is staged guiding intensive care. The Fournier severity index is calculated on admission. Nine physiological parameters are entered into the score. Temperature with heart rate and breathing is staged leading the list. Salts with kidney numbers and blood counts are staged following. Scores above nine are staged predicting over seventy five percent death.
steps.tx: **FGSI score** (Fournier danger scale) sums **9 parameters** (nine measures: temperature, heart rate, breathing, sodium, potassium, creatinine, haematocrit, leukocytes, bicarbonate) as a **severity index** (risk calculator); scores above **9** (nine) predict over **75% mortality** (three quarters death). Calculate on admission and trend daily. Escalate to intensive care early, because high scores deteriorate fast.

steps.say: Empiric cover is staged hitting every class upfront. MRSA with gram negatives and Pseudomonas are covered together routinely. Anaerobes are included from the first dose always. Piperacillin tazobactam with vancomycin is staged opening therapy widely. Clindamycin is added to block toxin synthesis. De-escalation is staged following culture reports daily.
steps.tx: **Empiric antimicrobial regimen** (first hour drug cover) must hit MRSA, gram-negative coliforms, Pseudomonas, and anaerobes with piperacillin-tazobactam plus vancomycin, adding clindamycin for **clindamycin toxin inhibition** (toxin factory block). Narrow on cultures after 48 hours. Never omit anaerobic cover, because synergy drives necrosis.

steps.say: Wounds are staged staying clean to heal properly. Urinary diversion is staged protecting the field. Suprapubic or urethral catheters are staged draining the bladder. Faecal diversion is staged using colostomy or bag systems. Contamination is staged halting with both routes together. Reconstruction is booked after wounds close fully.
steps.tx: **Urinary diversion** (bladder reroute) by suprapubic or urethral catheter plus **fecal diversion** (stool reroute) by colostomy or faecal management system keeps wounds clean. Divert early when the wound risks soiling. Reverse diversions after healing completes, because prolonged stomas bring their own morbidity.

steps.say: Septic shock protocols are staged running in parallel. Thirty mL per kg crystalloids are given within three hours. Blood cultures are drawn carefully before antibiotics. Broad spectrum drugs are staged starting within one hour. Source control is booked urgently alongside drugs. Lactate with urine output is staged tracking resuscitation.
steps.tx: **Urosepsis resuscitation** (sepsis bundle) gives **30 mL/kg** (thirty millilitres per kilogram) crystalloids within **3 hours** (three hours) with cultures drawn and broad-spectrum antibiotics inside **1 hour** (one hour), plus urgent surgical **source control** (cause removal). Reassess lactate and urine output hourly. Never delay source control for scans, because pus under pressure kills.
